anti_overcoordination.rule: When coordination is healthy and product work is available, do not create new support infrastructure unless it directly unblocks a named product work item.

rules: Advisory only; never auto-claim or authorize external writes.
Healthy coordination must bias toward current-focus product work.
Support work may outrank product work only when it explicitly unblocks product work, repairs unhealthy coordination, or satisfies a required validation gate.
Prefer existing help requests, handoffs and work_ids over creating new tasks.
Critical-path score must be explainable from priority, focus alignment, dependency impact, age and support penalty.
Do not persist chain-of-thought, credentials or private session state.
